content.content:
We need to create travel plan for 3 days, group of 7, departing from Appleton to Charlotte, dates March 18-20 2022. Budget $9,500. Accommodations allow visitors per house rules. We need to call submit_day_plan for each day (3 calls). Must include day number, current_city (likely Charlotte after arrival), transportation details (flight maybe), breakfast, attraction(s), lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We need to create plausible plan. No need to ask follow-up. Should we include flights from Appleton (ATW) to Charlotte (CLT). Provide flight numbers, times. Provide accommodations: maybe a vacation rental that allows visitors. Provide attractions: e.g., Discovery Place, NASCAR Hall, etc.

Breakfast could be at hotel. Lunch at local restaurant. Dinner at nice restaurant.

Also day 1 arrival: maybe flight morning, check-in, lunch, afternoon attraction, dinner.

Day 2 full day: breakfast, attractions, lunch, more attractions, dinner.

Day 3 departure: breakfast, maybe morning attraction, lunch, flight back.

Need to ensure budget fits $9,500 for 7 people: flights approx $300 each = $2100, accommodation maybe $250/night = $750 total, meals $50 per person per day = $1050. Total well under. So fine.

We must call function submit_day_plan for each day.

The function expects fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

If some field not applicable, use "-". Provide strings as described.

Let's craft.

Day 1 (March 18): transportation: Flight number (e.g., Delta 1234) from Appleton (ATW) to Charlotte (CLT), departure 07:00, arrival 10:30. Also maybe ground transport from airport to accommodation.

Breakfast: "Appleton Café, Appleton" (maybe before flight). Attraction: "NASCAR Hall of Fame, Charlotte;" maybe also "Mint Museum Uptown, Charlotte". Lunch: "Midwood Smokehouse, Charlotte". Dinner: "The Cowfish Sushi Burger Bar, Charlotte". Accommodation: "The Charlotte Villa, Charlotte (allows visitors)".

Day 2 (March 19): transportation: "-". Breakfast: "The Original Pancake House, Charlotte". Attraction: "Discovery Place Science, Charlotte; Freedom Park, Charlotte". Lunch: "Mert's Heart and Soul, Charlotte". Dinner: "Soul Gastrolounge, Charlotte". Accommodation same.

Day 3 (March 20): transportation: Flight back: Delta 5678 from Charlotte to Appleton, departure 12:00, arrival 15:30. Breakfast: "Hotel Breakfast Buffet, Charlotte". Attraction: "Levine Museum of the New South, Charlotte". Lunch: "Pinky's Westside Grill, Charlotte". Dinner: "-". Accommodation: "-".

Make sure to include city in each attraction.

Now call function three times.

json_schema.description:

If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
